QuestInfo.name: [Reputation] The Tabloids Strike!
QuestInfo.1: A star's reputation is their life. Teach those Star Paparazzi a lesson for taking humiliating pictures of Valerie, and bring her those pictures!
QuestInfo.2: Good thing you eliminated those Star Paparazzi. Her pictures were embarrassing, but that won't stop you from being Valerie's biggest fan!

0.0: It's a disaster, #b#h0##k! Valerie was coming home from practice yesterday, when the #rStar Paparazzi#k took a humiliating picture of her. I mean, I don't know how bad the picture is, but a star's image is her life! If Valerie wants to be the Maple Rising Star, we have to do something!
0.1: We must get that picture back, before it's used to harm her image. There's no time to lose! You're ready to help, right?\r\n

yes.0: The #rStar Paparazzi#k sometimes appear #bin the fields nearby the towns#k in Maple World. Well anyway, show them a lesson if you see them. And your mission will be complete if you bring back the #bHumiliating Picture Film#k!

no.0: How can you abandon her in a moment like this? What is wrong with you?

npc.0: Take the Humiliating Picture Film to Valerie in the Rising Star Hall. Let her decide what to do with it.

item.0: Hey, did you really find those pictures of me? You better make sure.
